required_events.event: Amy stirs eggs on the stove while Will and Amber chase each other around the kitchen, their laughter filling the room.
A gutted zombie rumbles through the front door, jaws snapping at the threshold of her home.
She grabs Will by the shoulders and scoops up Amber in a quick hug, sprinting down the hallway to the back bedroom’s locked oak-door safe location.

Turning toward the kitchen, she slips past the living room couch, pulls out a pistol from a hidden compartment beneath its cushion, then reaches for a katana on the pantry shelf and slides it into her hand.
She shoots the first gnarled zombie with the pistol, then slices its head off with the katana as it falls to the floor.
Another undead lunges at her, but she knocks it down with a swift thrust of the blade before more surge forward.
Each new zombie is met by quick shots and precise slashes until every one crumples around her in the kitchen.
After the last one falls, Amy runs back through the hallway into the bedroom’s safe door, opens it, pulls Will and Amber out together, breathing a sigh of relief as they step onto the kitchen floor.

phases.required_end_state: End at the expanded story's stated conclusion.
